claims.support: PfrlABCD-lux reporters in BW25113 and ΔfrlR JW5698; deletion increases reporter, ectopic FrlR represses. Shared promoter assays support regulation of operon; each gene's endogenous transcript was not individually quantified.
claims.qualifier: Use shared-promoter/operon inference on each gene-expression edge, not direct FrlR binding to each ORF or protein inhibition.

claims.support: Purified tag-cleaved FrlR binds operator-bearing DNA in SPR; KD4.9nM using active concentration correction. BL21(DE3) engineered T7/operator/sfGFP reporters and operator mutants test sequence dependence.
claims.qualifier: FrlR expressed His6-SUMO in BL21(DE3), tag removed with His6-Ulp1 and metal-affinity cleanup. Exact construction tables unread; no direct binding to individual gene products.

claims.locator: Article5–6, Fig5c; Methods4.5 article13; PDF89–90,97; finaljournal179–180,187.
claims.support: Arabinose-induced rpoH on pBAD33 stimulates PfrlABCD-lux reporters in BW25113 with promoter truncations.
claims.qualifier: Overexpression/reporter evidence, not purified sigma-promoter binding, native transcript measurement or rpoH deletion; do not turn warm-host adaptation discussion into host experiment.

claims.support: cyaA deletion JW3778 reduces reporter; ectopic cyaA restores/increases; glucose suppresses; removing candidateCRP region reduces response.
claims.qualifier: CRP-directed regulatory interpretation from cAMP manipulation and promoter dependence, not crp deletion or new purifiedCRP binding experiment. Methods/Fig5 specify20mM glucose but Results text says10mM; avoid exact single concentration without note.

claims.support: ε-fructoselysine-dependent reporter derepression requires FrlD in JW3337 comparison; FrlR pocket substitutions alter response.
claims.qualifier: Frl6P identity inferred genetically and by homology/mutation; no direct purifiedFrlR–Frl6P affinity or co-complex. Unphosphorylated ε-fructoselysine gives weak/absent in-vitro interaction.

claims.support: BW25113 growth on1mMε-fructoselysine; JW3337ΔfrlD loses growth;5mM24h substrate/lysine assay.
claims.qualifier: Mutant phenotype; no FrlD complementation shown in main figure.

claims.support: UTRA fragment aa78–244 self-interaction in E.coliKV1 two-hybrid and SEC/NMR consistent with dimer.
claims.qualifier: Fragment assays do not establish exact full-length native stoichiometry; main text describes full-length244aa but Fig2 alignment ends243; avoid unsupported exact full-length construct sequence.

exclusions: No individual frlA/B/C/D endogenous mRNA measurements.
FrlA transporter still presumed; Crr-mediated inducer exclusion explicitly hypothesis needing further experiments.
No direct CRP/protein-binding or RpoH/protein-binding edge from these reporter experiments.
No new chemistry or beta-G6P specificity experiment in schematicFig1.
Do not transfer B.subtilis/Salmonella cross-complementation as their native route regulation.
